sm_top.sm: The U.S. withdrew heavy bombers from RAF Fairford in the United Kingdom following a security incident.
Iran expressed willingness to facilitate dialogue between the Houthi movement and Saudi Arabia.
North Korea fired at least one ballistic missile.
Yemen's Houthis announced they targeted Riyadh airport with a ballistic missile.
Russia attacked Ukraine with drones, hitting energy infrastructure and power plants despite ceasefire pushes.
The Saudi-led coalition struck oil facilities west of Yemen's capital.
A cargo ship, identified as GFS Pride, sank after a mine strike south of the Strait of Hormuz.
Yandex reported a data center fire following a drone attack in Russia.
An explosion in northern Israel killed a teenager and injured others during a school trip.
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targeted ships with missiles and projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz.
The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln returned to San Diego following deployment.
Bulgarian officials say Russia likely behind recent Black Sea drone strikes as rescue operations continue.
The MI5 chief stated that Iran is targeting military sites and that a suspected plot at RAF Fairford is not unique.
Azernews reports 11 commercial ships have been attacked in and around the Strait of Hormuz since early October.
Malian forces supported by the Africa Corps regained control of Kidal following an extensive air operation.
Russian state media TASS claims Russian forces struck the ATM Ukrsibbank data center used by the Ukrainian military in Kyiv.
Houthi rebels reported airstrikes in Yemen amid ongoing regional conflict developments.
Ukrainian drones attacked Sberbank's data center in Russia's Saratov region, targeting AI infrastructure.
Moscow was targeted by a massive drone attack, with air defense systems shooting down drones overnight as airports temporarily closed.
Airstrikes hit Yemen's capital as a drone attack targets the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi shelling in Taiz killed six civilians and injured 18.
Israeli attacks and gunfire killed two Palestinians and injured others in Gaza in ceasefire violations.
A Russian missile strike on Kharkiv killed three people and injured 15, causing an apartment building section to collapse.
A Russian drone attack on western Ukraine killed 3 people and injured 20 in Lutsk and Rivne.
NATO launched its annual Steadfast Noon nuclear exercise in Italy with 17 nations participating.
NATO's top commander outlined a military response plan in the event of a Russian attack.
Incoming missiles or drones triggered alerts or strikes in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province.
Missile debris injured a resident and damaged a home in Riyadh.
Russian missile attacks killed people and left 600,000 residents without electricity across Ukraine.
Moscow reported an overnight attack involving nearly 500 drones, leading to the suspension of operations at four airports.
Iran launched ballistic missiles during military drills amid tensions with the United States.
Clashes between rival groups in Lakes state, South Sudan, left about 70 dead.
Ukraine launches nearly 900 drones at Russia as Kyiv braces for an expected massive aerial assault.
Overnight strikes on a combined heat and power plant caused power outages in Kyiv.
The Pentagon is sending a third aircraft carrier strike group and additional Marines to the Middle East.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes hit oil facilities in Yemen, prompting Houthi warnings of retaliation.
Russian drones struck Kropyvnytskyi, killing three people and injuring six others.
The European Union allocates €2.86 billion to Ukraine for drones and air defense systems.
Reports noted Houthi missile attacks hitting Aramco facilities, utilizing Chinese parts.
Ukraine launched over 900 drones in a massive attack across 20 Russian regions, targeting Moscow.
